term: actual esse support as concrete grounding
definition: At selected w, each existing R-supporter c of each existing concrete target n is an ActualConcreteGround: c is concrete, exists at w and grounds n at w. Thus a concrete-ground-minimal ancestor has no existing R-supporter. The converse is not asserted.
note: Explicit open analyst bridge. It excludes abstract supporters of concrete targets and support relations absent from grounds; neither arbitrary graph structure nor a causal word establishes it. All worlds and individuals are the same as the occurrence/grounding profile. This is not necessity implies underivedness. See docs/notes/occurrence-same-witness.md.
